title: Probe-driven profile annotations and release epitomizer
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds optional probe-driven sampling fields to model profile schema and a release epitomizer service that autogenerates compact release summaries and performance highlights. No customer-facing API changes; tooling and templates for internal release notes provided.
description: Motivation: onboarding churn showed repeated manual edits to release notes and missed performance regressions across hardware slices. This PR introduces a lightweight probe-driven annotation hook and a small 'release epitomizer' that synthesizes concise release blurbs from sampled profile deltas, coverage tags, and stability signals. Changes include schema extensions to model_profile v2 (optional fields only), a probe sampler CLI+server hook that attaches sample summaries to profile uploads, an epitomizer microservice that consumes profile deltas and emits short release snippets and context tags, and integration so the model registry auto-attaches an 'epitome' to onboarding drafts. Commits: "feat(schema): add optional probe_summary and stability_hint fields to profile v2"; "feat(probe): implement probe sampler CLI, upload hook and sampling config"; "feat(epitomizer): add microservice to synthesize short release summaries and perf highlight cards"; "chore(tests): add unit+integration tests for probe sampling and epitome generation"; "docs: document new schema fields, CLI usage and release note examples". Files changed (high-level): registry/schema/profile_v2.py updated to include new optional keys; onboarding/cli/probe_sampler.py new CLI; onboarding/hooks/upload_probe.py new upload hook; epitomizer/service.py new microservice; epitomizer/templates/short_blurb.j2 template; tests/probe_test.py and tests/epitome_integration_test.py added; docs/onboarding/probe_annotation.md and docs/releases/epitomizer_examples.md updated. Review and discussion summary: Arjun requested clearer boundaries for optional fields to avoid breaking older clients; author clarified fields are optional and backwards-compatible, added schema migration doc and compatibility tests. Lena asked for deterministic epitome outputs for identical inputs; added deterministic sorting and a fixed seed for sampling summarization. Tom flagged potential privacy note about sampled prompts; we added sanitization and a short privacy checklist to docs. CI: initial run showed lint and a flaky integration test failing on CI matrix p3-gpu, author fixed lint and stabilized the test by increasing a timeout and mocking external telemetry; subsequent CI run passed all checks. Merge notes: squash-and-merge on 2024-06-03 by Maya Chen. Rollout plan: feature gated by registry flag 'probe_epitome_enabled' default false; gradual enablement on canary orgs then broad rollout after 2 weeks of telemetry. Impact: improves release note quality and surface-level perf regressions; minor increase in profile upload time when probe sampling is enabled. Known limitations: epitomizer generates short, suggested blurbs that should be human-reviewed for final release notes; sampling config tunables live in onboarding/cli/config.yaml. Related work: builds on ENG-1987 (profile coverage sampler prototype) and complements PR ENG-2392 (changelog automation pipeline).
